dom.scene: A vintage hotel dressing room in warm midday window light. She perches upright on the edge of a luggage bench while folding a light robe into an open suitcase, one relaxed hand on the folded cloth and the other resting on the suitcase rim. A private travel-preparation fashion moment with a gentle smile, both hands and feet visible, one adult woman.
